origin: Independent rewrite of the GXP header, length-prefixed index, keyed XOR and template repack. Structure and keystream were taken from the decompiled third-party tool described below; no source lines were copied.

reference.tool: translation-helper v4.9D (decompiled research copy, not shipped)
reference.license_status: The tool embeds a GARbro-derived namespace family. GARbro is GPL-3.0; the exact commit, modifications and redistribution terms of this copy could not be confirmed.
reference.use: Header offsets, index record shape, 23-byte key table, per-entry XOR phase and payload encryption. Verified against the byte layout by synthetic round trips only.
reference.notice: Treated as a GPL-3.0-only lineage; no upstream source is required to use this skill.

cross_check.use: Cross-check only for the 0x30 index start and the 64-bit field family at 0x28; the shipped implementation uses the 32-bit payload offset that the synthetic layout and the tool agree on.

deviations: Strict range checks on every index record; the reference silently trusts lengths.
Rebuilt index must reproduce the original byte for byte when no member changed.
Archive name is required for the keystream instead of being guessed.
